prerequisites: Having taken the courses Elasticity and Strength of Materials I and II.
Having passed the courses Elasticity and Strength of Materials I and II.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of structures and industrial constructions

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering that involve the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to manage the activities that are the subject of the engineering projects described in competence CG01
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, plans

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional way and possess the competencies that are usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their area of study
Ability to apply knowledge in practice
Competence in applying ethical principles related to sustainability values in personal and professional behaviors
Competence in the sustainable use of resources and in the prevention of negative impacts on the natural and social environment
Be able to calculate and design structures and industrial constructions.

syllabus_topics: Design of structures and industrial constructions.
teaching_methods: Face-to-face or virtual campus tutorials, individual or collective
Practical classes: Exercise resolution, problem-based learning
Computer practices: Exercise and problem solving, application of a program (Finite Element Method or Matrix Calculation) for solving exercises and interpreting results

assessment_methods.method: Completion of assignments proposed by the professor
Final in-person exam to evaluate the overall learning outcome of the course
Progress tests according to the subject matter

assessment_rules: Exams will be held according to the official call. They will consist of exercises from each block, of the same level as those worked on during the course. The value of each proposed exercise will be indicated and review days for results will be established according to regulations. During exams, it is not allowed to take out or use mobile phones at any time.
